Build a LOSS/HOSS lookup table from an assessment spec

Source: R/spec_helpers.R
build_loss_hoss_lookup.Rd

Iterates over every subject (and grade, for span-tested subjects) defined in assessment_spec$subjects and returns a data frame of LOSS and HOSS values suitable for joining to student-level data.

Usage

build_loss_hoss_lookup(assessment_spec, cuts = FALSE)

Arguments

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

cuts

Logical. When TRUE, append a CUTS list-column holding each row's cut-score vector. Default FALSE.

Value

A data frame with columns SUBJECT (character), GRADE (integer, NA for EOC subjects), LOSS (numeric), HOSS (numeric), and — when cuts = TRUE — CUTS (list). One row per subject/grade combination that has a matching entry in assessment_spec$scale_scores.

Note that EOC rows carry GRADE = NA. Do not join this table to student data on SUBJECT + GRADE directly — states commonly report a real tested grade on EOC records, which would miss. Use join_score_bounds() instead.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_MS_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
build_loss_hoss_lookup(assessment_spec)
} # }
